explication: This repository distributes Llama model assets and provides a CLI for cataloguing, downloading, verifying, and removing them, plus native Llama 3 and Llama 4 inference code. The main usage paths are CLI request → model catalog/download → local checkpoint, and prompt → model-specific inference entry point → generated text. Llama 4 also includes image preprocessing and vision components; quantization is an optional inference path. The README documents these capabilities; sampled source confirms selected implementations, so unsampled wiring is left unspecified.
